exposure.printed: Samples of each element were given a stepped exposure of either green light only or blue and green light combined
exposure.blue_plus_green: blue and green light combined, stepped (filters, relative B:G balance not specified)
exposure.note: No source, filter, step increment, or exposure time is printed in this patent

process.name: KODAK FLEXICOLOR (C-41) process as described in British Journal of Photography Annual, 1988, pp196-198
process.note: No times/temperatures are printed in US6190848. US6309811 (same group) states 'Color negative development times are typically 3' 15" or less'. Standard published C-41 developer is 3:15 at 37.8 C (external knowledge, NOT from this patent).

measurement.contrast: Contrast of the elements was determined using the maximum slope between any two density points (of the measured sensitometric curve)
measurement.density_note: green (magenta) density of the receiver is implied; status M / densitometer not stated
measurement.interimage_metric: Cg/Cb+g = contrast of the green-only exposure / contrast of the green record of the blue+green exposure. Higher ratio = more inhibition from the blue (causer) affecting the green (receiver).
measurement.speed_metric_table_III: Relative green sensitivity (Table III); method stated for multilayers: speed point +0.15 density units above Dmin normalized to the check

layers_ML_C_0.name: Protective overcoat and UV filter layer

multilayer_test.additives_not_quantified: Surfactants, coating aids, emulsion addenda, sequestrants, lubricants, matte and tinting dyes were added to the appropriate layers as is common in the art.

variants.ML-C-1: Like ML-C-0, but IDIR-6 replaces IDIR-2 in layers 9 and 10 at equimolar levels (-> IDIR-6 ~0.0667 and ~0.0581 g/m2 computed with RDKit MWs; not printed)
variants.ML-C-2: Like ML-C-0, but IDIR-1 replaces IDIR-5 in layer 6 at 0.032
variants.ML-I-0: Like ML-C-0, but IEM-A added at 3x10^-4 in layer 5, 2x10^-4 in layer 6 and 2.9x10^-4 in layer 7
variants.ML-I-1: Like ML-C-0, but IEM-A added at 3x10^-3 (L5), 2x10^-3 (L6), 2.9x10^-3 (L7)
variants.ML-I-2: Like ML-C-0, but IEM-A added at 3x10^-2 (L5), 2x10^-2 (L6), 2.9x10^-2 (L7)
variants.ML-I-3: Like ML-C-0, but IEM-A added at 1.6x10^-3 in layers 9 and 10
variants.ML-I-4: Like ML-C-1, but IEM-A added at 1.6x10^-3 in layers 9 and 10
variants.ML-I-5: Like ML-C-2, but IEM-A added at 1.6x10^-3 in layers 9 and 10
variants.ML-I-6: Like ML-C-2, but IEM-A added at 1.6x10^-3 in layers 9 and 10 and IDIR-6 replaces IDIR-2 in layers 9 and 10 at equimolar levels
variants.units_caution: Units of the IEM-A additions are not printed (g/m2 is the document convention). Table IV states the same additions as 0.14 / 1.4 / 14 mmol IEM-A per mol Ag in every layer; neither g/m2 nor mmol/m2 reproduces that ratio exactly with the printed silver (g/m2 gives 0.095/0.080/0.10 mmol/mol for ML-I-0 L5/L6/L7). Treat Table IV ratios as nominal.

multilayer_test.exposure_protocol: Stepped exposure in one color record, only flashed (non-imagewise) in the other two records; processed as for the bilayers (C-41). Flash level / densities not printed.
multilayer_test.interimage_metric: Choose the causer step nearest density 1.5 in the stepped record; interimage = receiver density at that step minus receiver density at the causer's no-exposure step. More negative = larger receiver density drop = more interimage.
multilayer_test.speed_metric: speed point +0.15 density units above Dmin, normalized to the check
